title: Flower Petal Designer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Flower
learningObjectives: Calculate the rotation applied to each petal as 360 degrees divided by the number of petals, and confirm the result by varying the petal count from 3 to 20
Explain how the Control Point X and Control Point Y sliders move the quadratic Bezier control point to change petal curviness, and why a Control Point X of 0 yields straight triangular petals
Predict how increasing Petal Length changes both the petal tip distance and the center circle, which is drawn at 40 percent of that length
Compare a low petal count with long petals to a high count with short petals, and relate each result to real flowers such as trilliums and daisies
Design a target flower by coordinating the geometric and color sliders, and justify each parameter choice
